name: What is the difference between a small bathroom remodel and a powder room renovation?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a small bathroom remodel and a powder room renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: A small bathroom remodel typically refers to a full bathroom, including a shower or bathtub, toilet, and sink, often found in apartments or smaller homes. The renovation involves more extensive work, potentially impacting plumbing for the shower/tub. A powder room, on the other hand, is a half-bath with only a toilet and sink. Renovations for powder rooms are generally less complex and thus can be quicker and more affordable, as they don't involve wet areas like showers or tubs.
acceptedAnswer.description: A small bathroom remodel upgrades a full bath with a shower/tub, while a powder room renovation updates a half-bath with only a toilet and sink.
